items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch. The Woot API data-use item is blocked because official API access does not establish rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize deal data, and current terms point against the proposed use. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed; next action is a read-only data inventory covering identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, delivery, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4: evidence_needed; next action is capture deployed consent and withdrawal behavior plus GA4 property, data-sharing, retention, vendor, and jurisdiction evidence. Operational logs and Cloudflare data: evidence_needed; next action is a read-only log-field, retention, access, vendor/DPA, incident, and request-procedure inventory. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. No legal checklist item is closed.
